items.prompt:
The main position you argue is the:
A) claim
B) title
C) rhyme

An opposing claim in an argument is a:
A) counterclaim
B) conclusion
C) heading

The style of an argument essay should be:
A) formal
B) silly
C) angry

Why ACKNOWLEDGE and distinguish your claim from a counterclaim?
A) it shows fairness and makes your claim stronger
B) it weakens your claim
C) it is never useful
items.answer: A) it shows fairness and makes your claim stronger

solution.answer: A) it shows fairness and makes your claim stronger

items.prompt:
Which is the BEST evidence that a town needs a new library?
A) a survey showing 80% of residents lack nearby book access
B) 'libraries are nice'
C) 'my cousin likes to read'
items.answer: A) a survey showing 80% of residents lack nearby book access

steps: Relevant, credible data. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a survey showing 80% of residents lack nearby book access

items.prompt:
Words like 'furthermore,' 'in contrast,' and 'as a result' are used to:
A) clarify relationships between ideas
B) state the claim
C) add the title

Which sentence best introduces AND distinguishes a claim from a counterclaim?
A) 'Although some argue uniforms limit self-expression, they reduce bullying and save families money, which matters more.'
B) 'Uniforms are good.'
C) 'I like uniforms.'
items.answer: A) 'Although some argue uniforms limit self-expression, they reduce bullying and save families money, which matters more.'

steps: Names the counter, then rebuts. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) 'Although some argue uniforms limit self-expression, they reduce bullying and save families money, which matters more.'

items.prompt:
A well-built argument is organized to:
A) present a claim, support it with reasons/evidence, address counterclaims, and conclude
B) list random opinions
C) tell an unrelated story
items.answer: A) present a claim, support it with reasons/evidence, address counterclaims, and conclude

solution.answer: A) present a claim, support it with reasons/evidence, address counterclaims, and conclude
